stem.text: A transverse progressive wave of wavelength $\lambda$ is set up on a stretched string. The graph shows the variation of displacement $y$ with distance $x$ at a particular instant of time. The displacement where distance $x = \dfrac{\lambda}{8}$ is $y_1$.

stem.alt: Displacement y against distance x, a sinusoidal wave starting at the origin: y1 is marked at x = lambda/8 on the rising part; x-axis marks at lambda/8, lambda/2, lambda, 3lambda/2, 2lambda and 5lambda/2

stem.text: What are the next two values of $x$ where the displacement $y$ is again equal to $y_1$?
